profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft, I bring extensive experience in designing and optimizing large-scale distributed systems, including high-throughput services and operational monitoring infrastructures. My focus has been on maintaining, enhancing, and evolving Microsoft’s invoicing platform to support critical business needs.

With over six years at Microsoft, I’ve contributed to initiatives across billing, tax, invoicing, and overall system reliability. Notably, I’ve played key roles in features such as daily invoicing, subtotal-level taxation, and the internal platform known as InvoicingGates — solutions that directly impact customers and colleagues alike.

Passionate about performance and reliability, I strive to deliver scalable solutions that meet evolving business demands. I thrive in collaborative environments where innovation and precision intersect.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Improved reliability and performance of a high-throughput invoicing service generating over 1.5 billion invoices per month.

• Led the design and implementation of the InvoiceGate system, enabling pausing, resuming, and rewinding of invoice generation processes for greater operational flexibility.

• Designed and implemented a Daily Invoicing architecture, transitioning the system from monthly to daily invoice generation to support evolving business needs.

• Built a robust monitoring infrastructure using Azure Functions and Azure Data Explorer to track system health and surface critical issues.

• Developed and maintained ADX functions, tables, materialized views, and dashboards to streamline issue investigation and provide operational insights.

• Set up EV2 deployment pipelines for the Invoicing team, enabling service and infrastructure deployments—including Key Vault, SQL MI, App Services, Event Hubs, and monitoring—across low-side and air-gapped Azure environments.

• Acted as a mentor for new hires and vendors, maintaining onboarding documentation and serving as the primary point of contact for knowledge transfer.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
▪ Designed and launched NFT collections in the Solana blockchain through Solana web3JS and Metaplex Candy Machine.
▪ Authored website with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, NextJS, ReactJS and Typescript.
▪ Setup website hosting and an infrastructure to facilitate website updates and deployments through Git and Vercel.
▪ Created and deployed RUST programs, aka smart contracts, in the Solana blockchain.
▪ Built and launched SolFlip Cafe where anyone could try and bet on a coin flip to try and double or nothing their Solana tokens, through the use of Typescript and RUST Solana programs.
▪ Developed, deployed and hosted discord bots using Python and Sparked Host to keep track of NFTs being bought and sold across multiple marketplaces.
▪ Managed social media accounts, and discord server, with over thousands of followers and members.
▪ Collaborated with over 100 NFT projects within Solana and Ethereum blockchains.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
▪ Developed a Service Locator by building a RESTful web service in ASP.NET Core 2.0 Web API, and using Microsoft SQL Server to build and connect it's database.
▪ Designed an ASP.NET Core 2.0 MVC Web Application together with HTML, CSS and JavaScript to act as the front-end of the Service Locator, and implemented Swashbuckle Swagger to create documentation.
▪ Engineered, and built a .NET application that uses Entity Framework and Windows Forms and implements AWS API Gateway and AWS Lambda.
▪ Contributed in an Agile Software Development environment, and utilized TFS to coordinate tasks, and provide source control.

positions.title: Coordinator
positions.description:
▪ Implemented over 30 innovative lesson plans to introduce kids ages 5-15 to learn Python, Java, C/C++, front-end web development and Scratch. 
▪ Built and walked students through Raspberry Pi, Arduino, LittleBits, Microbit, Tinkercad and 3D printing team projects. 
▪ Facilitated on boarding process for all current instructors by training them on inhouse software and use of specialized hardware.

volunteerExperiences.description:
▪ Mentored kids aged 7-9 in designing, coding and creating an innovative way of filling a fish tank with water.  
▪ Conducted Lego based team building activities for the kids to improve on teamwork, critical thinking and communication skills

Junior Knights is a program at UCF that helps introduce programming to High School students. Its a series of classes ranging throughout fall and into winter every Saturday at 10am. I was able to help out the professor explaining C programming language and concepts, also answering any questions the students had.

projects.title: Classic Arcade Game
projects.description:
- Created a classic arcade game very similar to Frogger.
- Runs on browser and takes in user input from keyboard.
- Coded with an object oriented approach.
- TECHNOLOGIES USED: HTML, CSS, JavaScript

projects.title: Image Calculator
projects.description:
- Utilized Python and OpenCV to create a four-function calculator that takes in images of handwritten numbers, and solves equations. 
- Implemented supervised machine learning algorithm to analyze and create a classifier for the handwritten numbers.
